Bill.BriefDescription: Studying the community and technical college funding system.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to studying the community and technical collegefunding system; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The Washington state institute for publicpolicy shall study the feasibility of potential funding methods and afinance system for the incorporation of community and technicalcolleges into an expanded definition of basic education. TheWashington state institute for public policy shall complete its studyand make recommendations no later than December 1, 2006, to thegovernor, the state board for community and technical colleges, thehigher education coordinating board, the office of the superintendentof public instruction, and the fiscal and education committees of thesenate and the house of representatives.
